headline: Quarterly earnings per share more than double on the year
summary_short: Quarterly EPS was ¥267.72 versus ¥109.03 a year ago, up 145.5%, and up 11.0% from ¥241.27 in the prior quarter.
summary_long: Earnings per share of ¥267.72 compares with ¥109.03 in the same quarter a year earlier and ¥241.27 last quarter. These are the only verified figures on file; a web search found only first-quarter results of the fiscal year, so net sales, operating income, drivers and guidance for this period are not reported.
